title: S3 organiser programme change — preview/commit + LIVE planning proof (honest sandbox truth)

boundaries.note: counterfactual organiser preview through the real programme HTTP surface; deterministic, zero mutation
organiser commit fan-out through the real programme HTTP surface
Model Studio planning for the fan-out case through the provider-neutral model client; schema-validated, fail-closed
any planner-requested corridor evidence goes through the RECORD-mode Atlas adapter; sanitized recordings persisted

steps.description: Organiser Preview (counterfactual, no mutation): move future-provocation into the 09:50-10:10 Day-1 slot

assert.description: the preview evaluates the full event roster blast radius
the reschedule affects at least one linked trip
the blast radius is confined: exactly one trip is linked to the commitment
the engine derives the affected trip from the commitment linkage, not from the request
the affected traveller is resolved from the linked trip
an earlier session start is AT_RISK, not DISRUPTED: no hard constraint fails under the hypothetical state
the hypothetical engagement violates no trip constraint
the impact reason is derived from the engagement time change
every non-linked trip is evaluated and reported unaffected individually
non-affectedness is reasoned from linkage evidence, not assumed

steps.description: Counterfactual proof: between preview and commit the programme still shows the original state

assert.description: preview mutated nothing: no traveller is disrupted
preview mutated nothing: no traveller is at risk
the linked traveller is still in the original PLANNING state
no commitment is endangered before any commit

steps.description: Counterfactual proof: the linked trip itself is untouched by the preview

assert.description: the linked trip keeps its original viability status
no change narrative exists on the trip before the commit

steps.description: Counterfactual proof: preview opened no recovery case

assert.description: a counterfactual preview never opens recovery cases

steps.description: Organiser Commit fan-out through the same programme HTTP surface

assert.description: the commit is accepted through the real programme surface
the commit fans out to exactly the linked trip count derived by the engine
the engine reports the unaffected remainder explicitly
the commit produces fan-out change signals
the fan-out signal targets the linked trip
the signal is derived from the committed commitment change
fan-out opens a recovery case in the assessing state for the affected traveller
the commit executes without engine-reported issues

steps.description: Commit is REAL: the programme read model now reflects exactly one disrupted traveller

assert.description: the programme view is scoped to the anchor event
exactly one traveller flipped to DISRUPTED as a result of the commit
the disrupted traveller left the PLANNING bucket: state moved, roster total unchanged
the commit changes trip states, never the roster size

steps.description: The linked trip now carries the disruption narrative derived from the committed change

assert.description: the linked trip is now DISRUPTED
the change narrative names the exact engagement linked to the rescheduled commitment

steps.description: The fan-out case exists with deterministic constraint checks

assert.description: the opened case belongs to the affected trip
the case detail surfaces the disrupted viability
the case records the commitment change as its cause

assert.expected: arrival evidence must precede the linked commitment start
assert.description: the case evaluates the arrival-before-commitment constraint against the new start
no arrival evidence exists for this trip: the check stays UNKNOWN instead of guessing

steps.description: LIVE Model Studio planning for the fan-out case: the model gathers evidence through RECORD-mode adapters and proposes strategies; deterministic viability judges every candidate. Assertions pin only engine truths.

assert.description: the planning loop completed at least one round against live providers
at least one arrival candidate survives deterministic viability and is ranked
the fan-out case advanced through the planning stage

steps.description: Authority stage: the ranked strategy becomes a validated ActionIntent and the deterministic authority engine decides. Honest sandbox truth: the curated organiser policy is SGD-denominated while the live Atlas sandbox quotes USD, so the hard spend ceiling is incomparable and the engine fails CLOSED (ADR-045) — no FX invention, case escalated. This assertion pins that safety behaviour as the live ceiling.

assert.description: the strategy was staged as a validated action intent
the intent targets exactly the ranked strategy
the SGD ceiling cannot be deterministically compared to the USD gross spend: authority blocks instead of inventing FX
a blocked intent is never executable
the blocked intent escalates the case for human resolution
the blocking rule is named in the deterministic rule trace
the trace records currency incomparability as the fail-closed reason
ADR-037 allocation still resolves the fare to the event-funded baseline deterministically

steps.description: Authoritative case state after the fail-closed authority decision: escalated, never executed

assert.description: the case detail keeps reporting the trip's disrupted viability
the blocked intent stays queued for human resolution; nothing executed
the ranked option is surfaced as requiring approval, never auto-executable

steps.description: Authoritative runtime state at the honest live ceiling: no money-moving execution happened, trip state intact

assert.description: authoritative trip state remains observable
the escalated case stays open for human resolution instead of silently closing

steps.description: Semantic proof the commitment now holds the committed 09:50-10:10 window: re-previewing the identical proposal finds no temporal delta against authoritative state (no GET surface exposes raw commitment timestamps, so the engine's own counterfactual evaluator is the witness)

assert.description: the same proposal now produces zero affected trips: the authoritative commitment already starts 09:50 and ends 10:10
every trip, including the linked one, is now unaffected by the identical proposal
the previously affected linked trip is in the unaffected set
the engine reasons the proposal matches the committed engagement times exactly
